Records are terminated by CRLF, LF or a lone CR, and a single terminator at the very end of the document closes the last record without starting an empty one, so `"a\n"` and `"a"` both read as one record while `"a\n\n"` reads as two and `"\n"` reads as one record holding one empty field. An empty document has no records at all. Fields are never trimmed, and an empty field is preserved wherever it appears, including at the start or end of a record.

A field is quoted only when the quote character is its very first character: there, the field runs to the matching closing quote, a doubled quote character stands for one literal quote, and delimiters and line terminators inside the quotes are data rather than separators. A quote character anywhere else in a field is ordinary text.
